seeds.title: list --kind attempt returns attempt branches whose id is not a slice id
seeds.detail: List shows ids such as s-001a and s-0010. The prompt's id-equals filter handles it. Verified with S-001 against S-0010 and S-001a. No action needed.

seeds.title: Format {name:upper} is not a valid branch format
seeds.detail: branches.py accepts only {name} and {name:lower}. A prompt reader may expect {name:upper}. No change needed.
